annotations.visible_input_object: No biological/textual input object is visible; the figure only shows benchmark performance bars and a legend.
annotations.rationale: This panel is a results comparison plot, not an input-example figure. It does not visibly communicate the serialized prompts, biomarker profiles, or other input representation used by the model.

annotations.visible_input_object: Chest X-ray image with the task prompt at the top asking whether it is a normal chest X-ray.
annotations.visible_model_interface: Screenshot-style VQA prompt with the image shown on the left and the instruction text above it.
annotations.rationale: The left portion contains the actual radiology input and the text prompt interface, while excluding the model answers on the right.

annotations.visible_input_object: Tabula Sapiens single-cell transcriptome exploration interface with a UMAP embedding and chat request box.
annotations.visible_model_interface: Browser-like CellWhisperer UI showing score-based selection, visual selection, and a natural-language chat box.
annotations.rationale: Panel a is the smallest region that visibly shows both the biological data representation and the text-chat interface used to query cells.

annotations.visible_input_object: A text prompt about gene functions, shown in green input boxes labeled 'The function of gene...'.
annotations.visible_model_interface: Two grader components for truthfulness and structural correctness connected by arrows to the prompt.
annotations.rationale: This schematic directly shows the prompt input and the scoring interface, which is the relevant visible model interaction here.

annotations.visible_input_object: No input object is visible; the figure only shows a performance line plot over top-k values.
annotations.rationale: The plot reports downstream performance versus top-k candidate count, but it does not display the text prompt, retrieved documents, or other input representation entering the model.

annotations.visible_input_object: RNA/bulk-spatial transcriptomics, proteomics outputs, cellular-scale data, tissue H&E, and text clinical/pathology reports.
annotations.visible_model_interface: Multimodal workflow diagram with arrows into a central generative foundation model and a bridging H&E modality.
annotations.rationale: The top workflow panel is the smallest region that visibly communicates the multimodal inputs and how they enter the model.
